arguments.question: food-grade certificate requirement food contact gasket

content: No, we cannot buy from them. Under Rasoi's purchase policy (POL-PUR-001 §6.2) and supplier policy (POL-SUP-003 §4.1), parts that come into contact with food—specifically including gaskets—may only be purchased from suppliers holding a valid food-grade certificate on file in Bahi. Even if their price is lower, the certificate must be uploaded and verified before any order can be placed.
